name: Nindo: Always Fix What is Broken

system.description: This Nindo is one of restoration. When you cast a jutsu or use a feature that removed a Condition from an allied creature you can spend 2 Drive to mark them as Fixed for the next minute. A Fixed creature is treated as they have resistance to the condition originally removed by you.
